nodes.title: Save owns its form again under the footer portal
nodes.summary: The hypothesis revision screen's submit control keeps the screen's own form as its DOM form owner even when ButtonFooter portals it into the app shell's footer slot, restoring the save-to-revise dispatch the portal broke.

nodes.title: Save dispatches the revise, mounted against the footer portal the running application actually takes
nodes.summary: Proves the save control keeps the screen's own form as its DOM form owner and reaches the revise under the footer-slot portal, by mounting the hypothesis revision screen with a FooterSlotContext provider present rather than the bare-Outlet harness the earlier specs used.
